Four Courier-rejected source relics OldCoin/SmilingMask/MawBank/Courier were separately fetched and read: each canSpawn excludes ShopRoom. Author correctly does not forge a supposedly natural outer-loop hit from these inaccessible ordinary-shop candidates.

Source explicitly uses MathUtils for colored replenishment, so treating it as a normal run-seeded identity draw would be wrong.
